name: Exp_ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle custom indicator, which is a Schaff-style momentum oscillator with trend cycle smoothing. It opens buy positions when the oscillator rises above the high level and sell positions when it drops below the low level, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorSchaffMomentumTrendCycle自定义指标进行交易，该指标是Schaff风格的动量振荡器配合趋势周期平滑。当振荡器上穿高阈值时开多仓，下穿低阈值时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Schaff动量趋势周期指标，该指标结合了快慢双周期Momentum的差异与周期性循环平滑算法，产生0-100范围内的振荡值。入场条件：当指标Color缓冲区值大于5（对应振荡器处于高位区域，即高于HighLevel=+60）时产生做多信号，同时如果前一根K线Color值小于6则确认开多；当Color值小于2（对应振荡器处于低位区域，即低于LowLevel=-60）时产生做空信号，同时前一根K线Color值大于1则确认开空。出场条件：做多信号触发时同时平空仓，做空信号触发时同时平多仓，也依赖StopLoss和TakeProfit参数进行止损止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手，属于较为保守的设置。策略仅在新区块出现时计算信号，避免重复交易，使用SignalBar参数指定回看K线索引。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on the Schaff Momentum Trend Cycle indicator, which combines the difference between fast and slow Momentum periods with a cyclic smoothing algorithm, producing oscillator values in the 0-100 range. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's Color buffer value exceeds 5 (corresponding to the oscillator being in the high zone above HighLevel=+60), confirmed when the previous bar's Color value is below 6; a sell signal is generated when Color is below 2 (oscillator in the low zone below LowLevel=-60), confirmed when the previous bar's Color value is above 1. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and vice versa, while StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters provide additional risk exits. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, and percentage of balance after losses. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots, which is relatively conservative. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bars to avoid redundant trades, using the SignalBar parameter to specify the lookback bar index.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 风险管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/按保证金/按余额等）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing mode (free margin/balance/free margin minus floating loss/balance minus floating loss/fixed lot)

pros: 使用Schaff动量趋势周期指标，结合动量与循环平滑，信号更稳定
支持多种仓位管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
仅在新区块时计算信号，避免同一K线内重复交易
同时具备止损止盈和信号反向平仓的双重出场机制
买卖开关独立控制，可灵活仅做多或仅做空
pros_en: Uses the Schaff Momentum Trend Cycle indicator combining momentum with cyclic smoothing for more stable signals
Supports multiple position sizing modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
Signals are only calculated on new bars, preventing redundant trades within the same bar
Dual exit mechanism with both StopLoss/TakeProfit and signal-based reverse closing
Independent buy/sell toggle switches allow flexible long-only or short-only operation
cons: 依赖自定义指标iCustom调用，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
没有扩频过滤，在行情点差较大时仍可能开仓
没有持仓检查，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
信号逻辑基于Color缓冲区魔数（5,6,2,1），可读性差且难以维护
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator via iCustom call; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
Default StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are large, potentially leading to significant per-trade losses
No spread filter; trades may open during high-spread conditions
No position check before opening; may open duplicate positions in the same direction
Signal logic relies on Color buffer magic numbers (5,6,2,1), making it poorly readable and hard to maintain
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时禁止开仓
将Color缓冲区魔数替换为有意义的常量定义，提高代码可读性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate opening in the same direction
Add spread filter to prohibit trading when spread is excessively wide
Replace Color buffer magic numbers with meaningful named constants to improve code readability

risk_points: 默认止损1000点较大，单笔亏损风险较高
缺少持仓检查可能同向重复开仓导致仓位过重
没有点差过滤在高波动时段可能遭受滑点损失
依赖外部自定义指标文件，缺失时初始化失败
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stoploss is large, posing significant per-trade loss risk
Missing position check may cause duplicate same-direction positions leading to overexposure
No spread filter may cause slippage losses during high-volatility periods
Dependency on external custom indicator file causes initialization failure if missing
